summary: CityQuest Supabase backend regression — 29/29 pytest tests PASS (100%). Verified DATA_BACKEND=supabase is live: /api/supabase/health returns configured=true, cities_rows=4. Exact-count assertions match E1's spec: 164 Gaziantep POIs, 29 museum POIs, 57 Kultur Yolu sites (sorted by ky_seq asc), 20 dishes, 5 quests, 2 easy quests, leaderboard returns 50 rows sorted by xp desc. Full quest flow against q-gaz-1 works end-to-end on Supabase: GPS-good poi-gaz-1 check-in → awaiting_trivia=true → trivia_answer_index=0 → +75 XP + 'Mosaic Eye' badge + persisted in progress row. GPS-bad (0,0) correctly returns too_far=true with distance_m on both /api/progress/poi-check-in and /api/progress/check-in (anti-cheat ≤150 m). /api/progress/poi-check-in credits the matching quest (q-gaz-1) in quests_credited[]. /api/progress/{id}/by-city returns 4-city array with shape (total_quests, completed_quests, percent, completed, stamped_at). /api/progress/{id}/profile upserts display_name + avatar_uri for both new and existing rows. Pre-existing TEST_ok_142021ea user retrieved successfully. No backend issues found; Mongo→Supabase migration is functioning correctly across all 21 endpoints in scope.
action_items: No backend action items — Supabase migration verified clean.
Open items from iteration_1 remain (frontend only): map-tab WebView web fallback, hide Skip-GPS after result, shadow*/pointerEvents deprecations.
critical_code_review_comments: repo.py cleanly abstracts both backends; _sb_call wraps blocking supabase-py in asyncio.to_thread to keep event loop free. Good.
POIs sorted by ky_seq asc with nullsfirst=False in Supabase path — matches the Mongo .sort([('ky_seq',1)]) behavior on /kultur-yolu.
quests_for_poi uses jsonb contains (filter 'cs', json.dumps([poi_id])) — verified by full quest-credit flow.
progress_upsert hydrates NOT NULL defaults (xp=0, []/{} containers) before upsert on device_id — prevents constraint errors on first POI check-in.
/api/supabase/health is a smoke test only (counts cities). Safe to expose, returns no secrets.
Startup hook short-circuits Mongo seed when DATA_BACKEND=supabase — correct.

Server still imports motor + opens an AsyncIOMotorClient at module load even when Supabase mode is active (server.py L22-24). Not a bug but is dead overhead; consider lazy init or skip entirely if data_backend()=='supabase'. Low priority.
seed_data_creation: No manual seeding required — Supabase already contained 4 cities / 164 gaz POIs / 20 dishes / 14 quests / 50+ progress rows. Tests created several AUTO_TEST_<ts>_<rand> progress rows in the progress table that will appear on the leaderboard with xp=0 or xp=75 and display_name='Traveler'/'Halil Tester'/'Renamed'. Safe to leave; can be cleaned with: delete from progress where device_id like 'AUTO_TEST_%';
